offering_description.value: Owns and operates outdoor advertising displays, including billboards, street furniture, transit and airport displays, mainly in the United States and Europe. Sells advertising space to brands and agencies, with a growing share of digital displays.

primary_services.value: outdoor advertising space; digital display advertising; street furniture advertising; airport advertising; campaign services

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands and advertising agencies

end_markets.value: advertising; retail; media and entertainment; consumer brands

revenue_model.value: advertising: fees from advertisers for display space on billboards, street furniture and airport displays

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates billboards and street furniture on leased or permitted sites, selling space to advertisers

specialization.value: related lines: billboards, street furniture, transit and airport displays, digital displays

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to advertisers; agents / brokers: advertising and media agencies buying for brands; online: programmatic platforms for digital display buying

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: billboard zoning, permitting and content rules from local and state governments

notes: European footprint may have changed after divestitures.
